sentences.text: Scheme to Provide Electric Scooter to Disabled Person

**Scheme Brief Description:** The "Scheme to Provide Electric Scooter to Disabled Person" provides financial assistance of up to ₹25,000 for the purchase of electric scooters to eligible persons with orthopedic disabilities.
**Who is this for:** Individual; Category: Social welfare & Empowerment; Sector: Financial assistance

**Detailed Description:** The &quot;Scheme to Provide Electric Scooter to Disabled Person&quot; is a welfare scheme by the Social Justice and Empowerment Department of Gujarat. The scheme aims to promote mobility and independence for orthopedically disabled individuals in Gujarat by offering a financial subsidy. The beneficiary can purchase an electric scooter through an agency approved by JEDA. After verification, the financial assistance amounting to ₹25,000 (or 50% of the scooter and kit cost, whichever is lower) will be directly deposited into the beneficiary&#39;s bank account.
**Benefits / Assistance:** - **Financial Assistance:** Up to the limit of 50% of the basic cost of the electric scooter + 50% of the disability kit or ₹25,000/-.

**Application Process:** **Step 1:** Applications will be received under this scheme by publishing an advertisement. **Step 2:** Obtain and fill out the application form (available free of cost). **Step 3:** Submit the completed application form with required documents to the district-level office. **Step 4:** Eligible applicants are selected via computerized draw.
**Contacts & Authorities:** Nodal Department: Social Justice and Empowerment Department
**Tags:** Disability Person, Electric Scooter Subsidy, Orthopedic Disability, Below Poverty Level, BPL
